description: Registration data for any registrable domain, tracked or not: registrar and IANA id, created, updated and expiry dates, name servers, statuses, DNSSEC, registrant organization, name and country, and the abuse contact. Read live from the registry and the registrar; cached up to 1 hour. Needs a DomainDrift API key (Authorization: Bearer) on the connection; a name the registry does not hold answers not found and is not charged.
name: whois_lookup
title: WHOIS for any domain
